scanNote:
65-BET. Unit 9 — was/were va had (o'tgan zamon).

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. 11, 13 va 14a-mashqlarning javoblari TO'G'RI.

14a — sakkizta ixtiro, har birining yili rasm ostida yozilgan:
  ✓ (100 yil oldin BOR edi): hot-air balloons 1783, typewriters 1867, telephones 1876, cars 1886
  ✗ (hali YO'Q edi): TVs 1926, helicopters 1939, computers 1939, compact discs 1979

⚠⚠ VAQT NUQTASI MASALASI: mashq '100 years ago' deydi va chegara 1900-yil qilib olingan. Sababi — kitob taxminan 2002-yilda chop etilgan.
  ⚠ Agar BUGUNGI kundan hisoblansa, '100 yil oldin' boshqa yil chiqadi va TELEVIZOR (1926) javobi o'zgarib ketadi.
  ⚠ Bu kitobning xatosi emas: eski kitoblarda 'now', 'today', 'X years ago' KITOB YOZILGAN vaqtga nisbatan tushuniladi. Bola buni bilmasa, o'zini xato qilyapman deb o'ylashi mumkin — shuning uchun izohga qo'shildi.

⚠ IXTIRO SANALARI QAYTA TEKShIRILDI — hammasi tarixan to'g'ri: 1783 (Monbolye havo shari), 1867 (Sholz yozuv mashinkasi), 1876 (Bell telefoni), 1886 (Bens avtomobili), 1926 (Berd televizori), 1939 (Sikorskiy vertolyoti), 1939 (birinchi elektron kompyuterlar), 1979 (Philips-Sony kompakt diski).

⚠ 12-mashq 62-63-betlardagi Inishmore matniga tayanadi — o'sha betlar allaqachon tekshirilgan.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 64-betdagi 10-mashqning DAVOMI.

QOLIP:
  A: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the ...?
  B: Yes, of course. Go along/down ... Street, then take the
     first turning on your left/right. The ... is next to /
     opposite / between ... .
  A: Thank you very much.

CHAP-O'NGNI ANIQLASH:
  Yurish yo'nalishingizga qarab o'zgaradi!
  Hill Street bo'ylab PASTGA yursangiz — sharq CHAPDA.
  Hill Street bo'ylab YUQORIGA yursangiz — sharq O'NGDA.

items.prompt: a  You're at the bank and you want to go to the supermarket.
items.question: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the supermarket?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Go along King Street, then take the first turning on your right into Hill Street. Go up Hill Street. The supermarket is on your right, opposite the train station.
items.whyUz:
Siz bankdasiz (King Street ostida).
Supermarket shimolda, Hill Street ning O'NG tomonida.
King Street bo'ylab G'ARBGA yurasiz → Hill Street o'ng tomonda.
Hill Street bo'ylab YUQORIGA chiqasiz → supermarket o'ngda,
temiryo'l bekati ro'parasida.

items.prompt: b  You're at the supermarket and you want to go to the school.
items.question: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the school?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Go down Hill Street, then turn left into King Street. Take the first turning on your left into Apple Street. The school is on your right, opposite the cinema.
items.whyUz:
Supermarket shimolda, maktab esa Apple Street narigi tomonida.
Shaharda faqat 3 ta ko'cha bor — yuqorida ko'ndalang ko'cha YO'Q,
shuning uchun King Street orqali aylanib borasiz.
Maktab kinoteatr ro'parasida (9a-mashqning 1-bandi).

items.prompt: c  You're at the post office and you want to go to the sports centre.
items.question: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the sports centre?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Go along King Street and take the first turning on your right into Hill Street. Go up Hill Street. The sports centre is on your right, between the supermarket and the department store, opposite the hotel.
items.whyUz:
Pochta King Street ostida, restoran va kafe orasida.
Hill Street ning oxiri pochtaning G'ARB tomonida.
Sport markazi Hill Street ning sharq tomonida —
supermarket va univermag orasida.

items.prompt: d  You're at the cinema and you want to go to the department store.
items.question: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the department store?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Go down to King Street and turn right. The department store is on your right, next to the police station and opposite the museum.
items.whyUz:
Kinoteatr va univermag deyarli yonma-yon —
kinoteatr ostida militsiya bo'limi, uning yonida univermag.
King Street ga tushib, o'ngga burilish yetarli.
Univermag muzey ro'parasida (Hill Street narigi tomonida).

sections.title: Grammar — Was/Were (past simple of the verb "to be")
sections.titleUz: Grammatika — Was/Were ('to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni)

exercises.explanationUz:
WAS / WERE — 'to be' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ (Affirmative)      INKOR (Negative)
  I/he/she/it   WAS         I/he/she/it   WASN'T
  you/we/they   WERE        you/we/they   WEREN'T

  SO'ROQ (Interrogative)    QISQA JAVOB (Short answers)
  WAS I/he/she/it ...?      Yes, I/he/she/it WAS.
                            No, I/he/she/it WASN'T.
  WERE you/we/they ...?     Yes, you/we/they WERE.
                            No, you/we/they WEREN'T.

ESLATMA — HOZIRGI ZAMON BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  am  →  was        I am tired.   →  I was tired.
  is  →  was        He is happy.  →  He was happy.
  are →  were       We are late.  →  We were late.

MUHIM — 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
  'to be' fe'li so'roq va inkorda DID olmaydi.
     Were you at home?     ✓
     Did you be at home?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMALAR:
  was not  → wasn't
  were not → weren't

THERE WAS / THERE WERE:
  birlik  → There WAS a cinema.
  ko'plik → There WERE two shops.
  inkor   → There wasn't / There weren't
  so'roq  → Was there ...? / Were there ...?

points.noteUz:
BIRLIK egalar → WAS.
Misol: She was at school.

KO'PLIK va 'you' → WERE.
'you' birlikda ham WERE oladi!
Misol: You were late.

SO'ROQda 'was' gap boshiga chiqadi.
'did' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
points.noteUz:
QISQA javobda fe'l TAKRORLANADI.
'Yes, I was at home' emas — faqat 'Yes, I was.'

points.en: Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA JUDA SODDA:
  BIRLIK egalar (I, he, she, it)  → WAS
  KO'PLIK egalar (we, you, they)  → WERE

DIQQAT — 'I' G'ALATI:
  Hozirgi zamonda 'I AM' (alohida shakl),
  lekin o'tgan zamonda 'I WAS' — he/she/it bilan bir xil.

DIQQAT — 'YOU' HAM G'ALATI:
  'you' bitta odamga aytilsa ham WERE oladi:
     You were late, John.  ✓ (bitta odam)

items.textEn: We use ............ with I, he, she and it.
items.whyUz:
I, he, she, it — BIRLIK → WAS.
Jadvalning birinchi qatoridan olinadi.

items.textEn: We use ............ with we, you and they.
items.whyUz:
we, you, they — KO'PLIK → WERE.
'you' birlik ma'noda bo'lsa ham WERE oladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the list of prompts below, then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatga qarang, so'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: bicycles, fishing boats, restaurants, stone cottages,
        an airport, donkeys, souvenir shops, guest houses,
        green fields

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Were there any bicycles on Inishmore 50 years ago?
  SB: No, there weren't. Were there any ...

Javoblar 62–63-betdagi Inishmore maqolasiga asoslanadi:
  50 YIL OLDIN BOR EDI:  eshaklar, baliqchi qayiqlari,
                          tosh kulbalar, yashil dalalar
  50 YIL OLDIN YO'Q EDI: velosipedlar, restoranlar,
                          aeroport, sovg'a do'konlari,
                          mehmon uylari

DIQQAT — 'ANY' VA BIRLIK/KO'PLIK:
  KO'PLIK ot  → WERE there ANY bicycles?
  BIRLIK ot   → WAS there AN airport?
  'an airport' — BIRLIK! Shuning uchun 'Was there ...?'
  Bu ro'yxatdagi YAGONA birlik so'z.

QISQA JAVOB:
  Yes, there were.  /  No, there weren't.
  Yes, there was.   /  No, there wasn't.

items.question: Were there any bicycles on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
50 yil oldin faqat eshaklar bor edi — velosiped yo'q edi.
'bicycles' ko'plik → WERE there ANY.

items.question: Were there any fishing boats on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'only donkeys and fishing boats'.
Baliqchilik — orolning asosiy kasbi edi.

items.question: Were there any restaurants on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz: Restoranlar sayyohlar bilan birga KEYIN paydo bo'lgan.

items.question: Were there any stone cottages on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'They only had small stone cottages'.
Hozir esa 'modern houses'.

items.question: Was there an airport on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
DIQQAT: 'an airport' — BIRLIK →
'WAS there AN airport?' ('Were there any' XATO).
Aeroport hozir bor, 50 yil oldin yo'q edi.

items.question: Were there any donkeys on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: mashina yo'q edi, faqat eshaklar.
'a donkey' = eshak.

items.question: Were there any souvenir shops on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz: Sovg'a do'konlari sayyohlik rivojlangach ochilgan.

items.question: Were there any guest houses on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
'a guest house' = mehmon uyi (kichik mehmonxona).
Bu ham sayyohlik bilan paydo bo'lgan.

items.question: Were there any green fields on Inishmore 50 years ago?
items.whyUz:
Yashil dalalar HAM O'SHANDA, HAM HOZIR bor —
63-betda Coneely dalalarga qarab turibdi.
Orolda o'zgarmagan narsalardan biri.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in were, was or wasn't, then listen and check. In pairs, use the prompts to act out a similar dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: were, was yoki wasn't ni qo'ying, so'ng tinglab tekshiring. Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WERE you at home last night?
  B: No, I WASN'T. I WAS at the cinema.
  A: Who WERE you with?
  B: I WAS with Claire.
  A: How WAS the film?
  B: Well, it WASN'T very good. It WAS boring. Where WERE you?
  A: I WAS at home.
  B: WERE you with Sally?
  A: No, I WASN'T. She WAS at work.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding?
  B: Yo'q, emasdim. Kinoteatrda edim.
  A: Kim bilan eding?
  B: Kler bilan edim.
  A: Kino qanday edi?
  B: Ha, unchalik yaxshi emasdi. Zerikarli edi. Sen qayerda eding?
  A: Men uyda edim.
  B: Salli bilan midingiz?
  A: Yo'q, emasdim. U ishda edi.

DIQQAT — RO'YXATDA 'weren't' YO'Q:
  Mashqda faqat were, was, wasn't berilgan —
  demak inkorlar HAMMASI birlik ega bilan keladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  last night = kecha kechqurun
  Who were you with? = Kim bilan eding?
  boring = zerikarli
  at work = ishda

lines.whyUz:
'you' → WERE.
So'roq gap: WERE gap boshida.
'last night' = kecha kechqurun.

'I' → was; inkor → WASN'T.
Qisqa javobda faqat 'No, I wasn't.' deyiladi.

'you' → WERE.
'Who were you with?' = Kim bilan eding?
DIQQAT: 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

'the film' — BIRLIK ot → WAS.
'How was ...?' = ... qanday edi?

lines.hintUz: Ma'no INKOR — keyin 'It was boring' deyiladi
lines.whyUz:
'it' → was; ma'no inkor → WASN'T.
'It wasn't very good' = unchalik yaxshi emasdi.
Keyingi gap ('It was boring') buni tasdiqlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to act out a similar dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMALAR:
  at a restaurant - Sharon - the food - not very nice -
  horrible - Craig - at a football match

Har bir ko'rsatma 13-mashqdagi bitta so'zning O'RNIGA qo'yiladi:
  at the cinema     → at a restaurant
  Claire            → Sharon
  the film          → the food
  (wasn't) very good → (wasn't) very nice
  boring            → horrible
  Sally             → Craig
  at work           → at a football match

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  horrible = dahshatli, juda yomon
  a football match = futbol o'yini

items.prompt: at a restaurant - Sharon - the food - not very nice - horrible - Craig - at a football match
items.question: Were you at home last night?
items.answer: No, I wasn't. I was at a restaurant. — Who were you with? — I was with Sharon. — How was the food? — Well, it wasn't very nice. It was horrible. Where were you? — I was at home. — Were you with Craig? — No, I wasn't. He was at a football match.
items.whyUz:
13-mashqdagi qolip bir xil, faqat so'zlar almashtirildi.
DIQQAT — 'She was at work' o'rniga 'HE was at a football match':
Craig — o'g'il bolaning ismi, shuning uchun 'he'.
'horrible' = dahshatli — 'boring' dan ham kuchliroq salbiy baho.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAD — 'have' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ         I/you/he, etc  HAD
  INKOR          I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T HAVE
  SO'ROQ         DID  I/you/he, etc  HAVE?
  QISQA JAVOB    Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
                 No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL:
  I had, you had, he had, she had, it had,
  we had, they had — HAMMASI 'HAD'.
  Hech qanday -s yoki boshqa shakl YO'Q.
  (Hozirgi zamonda: I have, he HAS — farq bor edi.)

DIQQAT — INKOR VA SO'ROQDA 'HAVE' QAYTADI:
  I didn't HAVE a car.    ✓
  I didn't HAD a car.     ✗ XATO
  Did you HAVE a car?     ✓
  Did you HAD a car?      ✗ XATO
  Sabab: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan,
  ikkinchi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda qoladi.

WAS/WERE bilan SOLISHTIRING:
  'to be' → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  'have' → did KERAK:        Did you have a car?

points.noteUz:
HAMMA ega uchun BIR XIL: HAD.
Misol: They had donkeys.

points.en: I / you / he, etc didn't have
points.noteUz:
INKOR: didn't + HAVE (had EMAS!).
Misol: They didn't have helicopters.

points.en: Did I / you / he, etc have?
points.noteUz:
SO'ROQ: Did + ega + HAVE.
Misol: Did they have computers?

points.en: Yes, I / you / he, etc did.
No, I / you / he, etc didn't.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Tick (✓) what people had 100 years ago and put a cross (✗) next to what they didn't have. Then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. 100 yil oldin odamlarda BOR bo'lgan narsalarga ✓, YO'Q bo'lganlariga ✗ qo'ying. So'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir rasm ostida IXTIRO QILINGAN YILI yozilgan.
Qoida juda oddiy:
  yil 1900 dan OLDIN  → ✓ (100 yil oldin bor edi)
  yil 1900 dan KEYIN  → ✗ (hali ixtiro qilinmagan edi)

SAKKIZ NARSA (yillari bilan):
  hot-air balloons  1783  →  ✓
  typewriters       1867  →  ✓
  telephones        1876  →  ✓
  cars              1886  →  ✓
  ───────── 1900 ─────────
  TVs               1926  →  ✗
  helicopters       1939  →  ✗
  computers         1939  →  ✗
  compact discs     1979  →  ✗

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did they have helicopters?
  SB: No, they didn't. Did they have ...

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a hot-air balloon = havo shari
  a typewriter      = yozuv mashinkasi
  a compact disc (CD) = kompakt disk
  a helicopter      = vertolyot

⚠⚠ DIQQAT — '100 YIL OLDIN' QAYSI YILDAN?

  Mashqda '100 years ago' deyilgan va
  chegara 1900-yil qilib olingan.

  ⚠ Sababi: bu kitob taxminan 2002-yilda
  chop etilgan. O'shanda '100 yil oldin'
  = ~1900-yil edi.

  ⚠ Agar BUGUNDAN hisoblasangiz, '100 yil
  oldin' boshqa yil chiqadi va TELEVIZOR
  (1926) javobi O'ZGARIB KETADI.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun bu mashqda chegara
  1900-yil deb OLINADI — kitob shunday
  mo'ljallagan.

  ⚠ Bu xato emas: eski kitoblarda 'now',
  'today', 'X years ago' kabi so'zlar
  KITOB YOZILGAN vaqtga nisbatan
  tushuniladi.


⚠ IXTIRO SANALARI TEKShIRILDI — HAMMASI
TO'G'RI:
  1783 — aka-uka Monbolyelarning havo
     shari (birinchi odamli parvoz)
  1867 — Sholzning yozuv mashinkasi
  1876 — Bellning telefoni (patent)
  1886 — Bensning birinchi avtomobili
  1926 — Berdning televizor namoyishi
  1939 — Sikorskiyning vertolyoti
  1939 — birinchi elektron kompyuterlar
  1979 — Philips va Sony kompakt diski

items.whyUz:
1939 > 1900 → ✗ (yo'q edi).
Savol-javob: Did they have helicopters? — No, they didn't.
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA shu.

1783 < 1900 → ✓ (bor edi).
Havo shari — eng qadimgi uchish vositasi.
Did they have hot-air balloons? — Yes, they did.

1867 < 1900 → ✓.
Yozuv mashinkasi — kompyuterning 'bobosi'.
Did they have typewriters? — Yes, they did.

1926 > 1900 → ✗.
'TV' = television ning qisqartmasi.
Did they have TVs? — No, they didn't.

1939 > 1900 → ✗.
Vertolyot bilan BIR YILDA.
Did they have computers? — No, they didn't.

1876 < 1900 → ✓.
Did they have telephones? — Yes, they did.

1886 < 1900 → ✓.
DIQQAT: mashina BOR edi, lekin Inishmore orolida
YO'Q edi (62-63-bet) — dunyoda bor, orolda yo'q.

1979 > 1900 → ✗.
Ro'yxatdagi ENG YANGI ixtiro.
Did they have compact discs? — No, they didn't.

exercises.instructionEn: Now write sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  They had hot-air balloons 100 years ago, BUT they didn't
  have helicopters.

QOLIP:
  They HAD [✓ narsa] 100 years ago, BUT they DIDN'T HAVE
  [✗ narsa].

Har bir gapda BITTA ✓ va BITTA ✗ juftlashtiriladi.
Ma'no jihatidan yaqin juftlarni tanlash yaxshiroq:
  yozuv mashinkasi ↔ kompyuter (yozish vositalari)
  telefon ↔ televizor (aloqa/media)
  mashina ↔ kompakt disk

DIQQAT — 'BUT':
  'but' ikki QARAMA-QARSHI fikrni bog'laydi.
  Oldidan vergul qo'yiladi: ..., but ...

DIQQAT — 'DIDN'T HAVE' ('didn't had' EMAS):
  they didn't HAVE   ✓
  they didn't HAD    ✗ XATO

items.answer: They had hot-air balloons 100 years ago, but they didn't have helicopters.
items.whyUz:
1783 (✓) va 1939 (✗).
Qolip: HAD ... , but they DIDN'T HAVE ... .

items.answer: They had typewriters 100 years ago, but they didn't have computers.
items.whyUz:
1867 (✓) va 1939 (✗).
Yozuv mashinkasi bor edi, kompyuter yo'q edi.

items.answer: They had telephones 100 years ago, but they didn't have TVs.
items.whyUz:
1876 (✓) va 1926 (✗).
Telefon televizordan 50 yil oldin ixtiro qilingan.

items.answer: They had cars 100 years ago, but they didn't have compact discs.
items.whyUz:
1886 (✓) va 1979 (✗).
Ro'yxatdagi eng erta va eng kech ixtirolardan.

exercises.instructionEn: First answer these questions, then write a short paragraph (40-60 words) about yourself when you were seven years old.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval bu savollarga javob bering, so'ng yetti yoshingizda qanday bo'lganingiz haqida qisqa matn (40-60 so'z) yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH SAVOL:
  a  What was your best friend like?
  b  What was your favourite teacher like?
  c  What was your favourite toy?
  d  Did you have a pet? (What?)
  e  What was your favourite food/drink?

MUHIM GRAMMATIKA — HAMMASI O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  'to be'  → was / were  (did KERAK EMAS)
  'have'   → had / didn't have / Did you have?

DIQQAT — 'What ... LIKE?':
  'What was he like?' = U qanday odam edi? (XARAKTER)
  Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     He was funny and kind.  ✓
     He was like funny.      ✗ XATO

NAMUNA MATN (52 so'z):
  When I was seven years old, my best friend was Aziz.
  He was funny and very kind. My favourite teacher was
  Mrs Karimova. She was patient and she was never angry.
  My favourite toy was a red car. I had a pet — a small
  cat called Mosh. My favourite food was plov and my
  favourite drink was apple juice.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Men yetti yoshda edim. Eng yaqin do'stim Aziz edi.
  U qiziqarli va juda mehribon edi. Sevimli o'qituvchim
  Karimova opa edi. U sabrli edi va hech qachon
  jahli chiqmasdi. Sevimli o'yinchog'im qizil mashina edi.
  Uy hayvonim bor edi — Mosh ismli kichkina mushuk.
  Sevimli taomim palov, sevimli ichimligim olma sharbati edi.

FOYDALI SIFATLAR (xarakter uchun):
  funny (qiziqarli), kind (mehribon), friendly (do'stona),
  patient (sabrli), strict (qattiqqo'l), clever (aqlli),
  quiet (kamgap), noisy (shovqinli)

structure.heading: a  Best friend
structure.guideUz:
'What was your best friend like?' — XARAKTER so'ralmoqda.
Qolip: My best friend was [ism]. He/She was [sifat] and [sifat].
structure.modelEn: My best friend was Aziz. He was funny and very kind.

structure.heading: b  Favourite teacher
structure.guideUz:
Yana XARAKTER.
Qolip: My favourite teacher was [ism]. He/She was [sifat].
structure.modelEn: My favourite teacher was Mrs Karimova. She was patient and she was never angry.

structure.heading: c  Favourite toy
structure.guideUz:
'What WAS' — narsa so'ralmoqda, xarakter emas.
Qolip: My favourite toy was [o'yinchoq].
structure.modelEn: My favourite toy was a red car.

structure.heading: d  Pet
structure.guideUz:
'DID you HAVE a pet?' — bu yerda 'have' fe'li → DID kerak.
Qolip: I had [hayvon]. / I didn't have a pet.
structure.modelEn: I had a pet — a small cat called Mosh.

structure.heading: e  Favourite food and drink
structure.guideUz:
Ikkalasini BITTA gapda 'and' bilan bog'lash mumkin.
Qolip: My favourite food was [taom] and my favourite drink was [ichimlik].
structure.modelEn: My favourite food was plov and my favourite drink was apple juice.

wordFormation.introUz: 65-bet — was/were va had (o'tgan zamon), ixtirolar lug'ati.

groups.explanationUz: Uchta hozirgi shakl IKKITA o'tgan shaklga siqiladi.
O'tgan zamonda hamma ega uchun BITTA shakl.
14-mashqdagi sakkiz narsa — ixtiro yili bo'yicha tartibda.

patterns.exampleEn: I was at home. They were at school.
patterns.exampleUz: Men uyda edim. Ular maktabda edi.

patterns.formula: WAS / WERE + ega + ...?  → Yes, ... was/were. / No, ... wasn't/weren't.
patterns.exampleEn: Were you at home last night? — No, I wasn't.
patterns.explanationUz: 'to be' so'roqda DID OLMAYDI — fe'lning o'zi oldinga chiqadi.

patterns.formula: WAS there a/an + birlik?  /  WERE there any + ko'plik?
patterns.exampleEn: Was there an airport? Were there any bicycles?
patterns.explanationUz:
Ot BIRLIK bo'lsa WAS, KO'PLIK bo'lsa WERE.
Ko'plikda 'any' qo'shiladi.

patterns.formula: Ega + HAD + ... .   (hamma ega uchun bir xil)
patterns.exampleEn: They had typewriters. She had a cat.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda yozuv mashinkasi bor edi. Unda mushuk bor edi.

patterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T HAVE + ... .   /   DID + ega + HAVE + ...?
patterns.exampleEn: They didn't have computers. Did they have helicopters?
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda kompyuter yo'q edi. Ularda vertolyot bormidi?
patterns.explanationUz: 'did/didn't' dan keyin HAVE (had EMAS) — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

patterns.formula: They had X 100 years ago, BUT they didn't have Y.
patterns.exampleEn: They had hot-air balloons 100 years ago, but they didn't have helicopters.
patterns.exampleUz: 100 yil oldin havo sharlari bor edi, lekin vertolyotlar yo'q edi.

patterns.exampleEn: What was your best friend like? — He was funny and kind.
patterns.exampleUz: Eng yaqin do'sting qanday edi? — U qiziqarli va mehribon edi.
